## Summary

I added a `currency` setting to the `Config` dataclass with a default value of `"USD"`. The setting is automatically configurable via the `ledger.toml` file—users can add `currency = "EUR"` (or any other value) to override the default, following the same pattern as the existing `db_path` and `rates_url` settings.

The implementation was straightforward because the `load()` function already dynamically discovers all dataclass fields via `fields(Config)`, so no changes to the loading logic were needed. All tests pass.
